name: Image Info
description: Inspect dimensions, EXIF, GPS and colors, and remove metadata losslessly
help: Shows the format, dimensions, aspect ratio and color type of an image, plus every EXIF tag it carries.
Camera, lens and exposure settings are summarized; GPS coordinates can be opened in a map.
The dominant colors are extracted locally; click a swatch to copy its hex value.
Remove metadata deletes EXIF, XMP, IPTC and text chunks from JPEG and PNG files without re-encoding, so the pixels stay identical. The color profile is kept.

open.hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, GIF, TIFF and ICO
